title: Great animal print cup cake cups!
text: Great animal print cup cake cups!. These are super cute. I ordered them when I was making cupcakes for a preschool 'What animal would you like to be' party for my grandson. Colorful, different, unique. I love the fact that you can purchase theme-based baking cups like this. In addition to being unique, they are also practical and produce perfectly shaped cupcakes. Perfect for any stylized party needs you might have.

product_metadata.title: Fox Run Funky Animal Prints Bake Cup Set, 3 x 3 x 1.25 inches, Multicolored
features: Standard size, approx. 3 x 3 x 1.25 inch
Food-safe printed, fluted paper baking cups
Pack of 75 funky animal print liners in blue, purple and pink
Place in muffin tin and fill with your favorite batter
Dress up your cupcakes for your next party
description: Make your cupcakes stand out and be the highlight of the party! These funky animal print bake cups are sure to set a fun tone to your next party or celebration. This set includes 75 standard size food-safe, fluted paper baking cups, so you can bake and serve tons of cupcakes for your guests. Included colors are blue, purple, and pink! Simply place in a muffin tin and fill with your favorite batter to dress up your cupcakes.
